key_results.result: Screening of a collection of Bacillus strains with primers Vipϩ and VipϪ revealed the presence of a 1-kb PCR product for strain ucr8, which was cloned in pGEM-T Easy for sequencing.

key_results.result: Seven clones were analyzed by digestion with EcoRI, and two patterns were observed.

key_results.result: Six of the clones, 8V1 to 8V6, had two EcoRI sites that generated 200-bp and 900-bp fragments, whereas clone 8VA had only one EcoRI site (data not shown).

discussion_points.point: It is likely that some of these cysteines are involved in disulfide bridges and may play a role in the stability of Vip3Ba1.
discussion_points.quote: It is likely that some of these cysteines are involved in disulfide bridges and may play a role in the stability of Vip3Ba1.

discussion_points.point: Deletion analyses of both the N terminus and the C terminus might provide more detailed information about the insecticidal moiety of the protein, as they have for Vip3A proteins (22).
discussion_points.quote: Deletion analyses of both the N terminus and the C terminus might provide more detailed information about the insecticidal moiety of the protein, as they have for Vip3A proteins (22).

discussion_points.point: Since Vip3Ba1 is closely related to Vip3A proteins, it most likely acts as a single toxin.
discussion_points.quote: Since Vip3Ba1 is closely related to Vip3A proteins, it most likely acts as a single toxin.

discussion_points.point: However, due to the failure to demonstrate lethal activity, the involvement of a partner protein cannot be formally excluded.
discussion_points.quote: However, due to the failure to demonstrate lethal activity, the involvement of a partner protein cannot be formally excluded.

discussion_points.point: Further investigation is therefore needed to unravel the mode of action of Vip3Ba1 and to understand the role of the specific features observed.
